In an undirected graph, the nodes are numbered from 0 to 10, and every node has an embedding. (i,j) means that node i and node j are connected with an undirected edge.
Embeddings:
node 0: [1,0]
node 1: [0,1]
node 2: [0,0]
node 3: [1,1]
node 4: [0,1]
node 5: [0,1]
node 6: [0,0]
node 7: [1,0]
node 8: [0,0]
node 9: [1,0]
node 10: [1,0]
The edges are: (0,4) (0,6) (0,5) (1,3) (1,4) (2,4) (3,6) (3,5) (5,8) (5,10) (6,7) (6,9) (7,8) (8,10) (9,10)
In a simple graph convolution layer, each node's embedding is updated by the sum of its neighbors' embeddings.
Q: What's the embedding of each node after one layer of simple graph convolution layer?
A:

Return only a JSON object using this schema: {"node_embeddings":{"0":[0,0]}}. Do not output explanations.
